title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E6 — Growing Fruit and Berries
Martha shares tips on the many different varieties of fruits and berries she cultivates on her farm; a lesson on growing raspberries, currants, and blueberries; Matt Kaminsky teaches Martha how to prune and care for her hundred-year-old apple trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E1 — Martha's Amazing Maze and How to Grow Trees From Seedlings
Martha's new passion project is the maze she's building on her Bedford farm; she shares her plans and inspiration for the project and teaches the proper measuring, staking and fertilizing techniques to properly plant successful trees.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E2 — Everything You Need To Know About Conifers
Martha shows how to properly move an established tree on her very own Christmas tree farm; she gives a tour of her pinetum where she teaches about new and unusual conifer trees.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E9 — Exploring Korean Cuisine
Martha dines at the Korean restaurant NARO and begins her culinary journey with two Korean cocktails; Martha and executive chef Nate Kuester make reimagined versions of traditional Korean cuisine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E10 — Martha's Favorite Brunch
Martha prepares a brunch menu with whitefish salad from Acme Smoked Fish Corp and crafts a cocktail featuring two brunch staples; Martha makes her favorite frittata dish and bakes a rhubarb crisp.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E1 — Ice Cream Show
Martha makes homemade ice cream with Van Leeuwen Ice Cream co-founder, Ben Van Leeuwen; Martha assembles ice cream sandwiches with homemade cookies and makes hot fudge.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E3 — Mexican Cuisine
Chef Lazaro Perez joins Martha in her kitchen to cook a fiesta-inspired feast of carnitas and homemade tortillas, shrimp in a spicy chili sauce, and the iconic Martha-rita.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E4 — Arethusa Farm Dairy's Award Winning Cheese
Martha road trips to Arethusa Farm in Bantam, CT, and learns how they make their award-winning Europa cheese, visits their cheese caves, and makes their delicious cheesy risotto recipe.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E5 — Brioche, Tarts and Pie
Chef Margarita Lorenzana-Manzke visits Martha's Maple Avenue kitchen and shares recipes of her famous staples from her restaurant, Republique, like banana caramel cream pie and brioche loaves.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E6 — Tomato Show
Martha shares her favorite tomato recipes from a tomato tart to Martha's favorite BLT to a simple marinara sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E7 — French Bistro Night
Martha gets a first-hand look behind the delicious French dishes at Cenadou Bistro including mussels in a tomato sauce with house-made croutons and a flatbread topped with olives and anchovies.
